{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust downward for persistent overestimation in early forecast periods when sentiment is consistently low.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias correction when true outcomes deviate significantly from recent 5-day average, especially in low-sentiment periods.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history includes multiple negative entries (e.g., >2 consecutive negative sentiment values).",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent high volatility; smooth out forecast transitions if sentiment remains flat or mildly negative.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast in the first 5 days of the 30-day window, reduce initial forecast values by 5–10%.",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a negative streak, gradually increase forecast by 3–5% per day to reflect sentiment shift."
  ]
}
